summary: All three scoped target claims received counter-evidence with at least one independent-methodology source, so the opposing side was sufficient to critique; no bounce. Original side: 6 claims held (RightNow as a large on-persona base with no public vendor on-ramp; 4.5M users as cumulative; Planning Center's free self-serve developer program; Planning Center's relative scale lead; Planning Center as best actionable-now on-ramp, narrowed; Lifeway 200K+ as uncorroborated), 4 failed or were overstated (the 'no current first-party figure' premise for Planning Center is falsified by its own product pages stating 78,000+; the 73K/78K/80K figures share one vendor origin so there was never a real two-source contest; install base was conflated with reach; the 2M-download 'corroboration in kind' for Lifeway is both the wrong unit and apparently for a show no longer on the network). Counter side: 3 claims held (78,000+ first-party figure discredits faith.tools' 100K+; G2/Capterra relative-scale corroboration; honest null result on Lifeway), 2 were overstated (the Form 990 revenue arithmetic actually points to ~20,000 paying organizations rather than 'roughly consistent with 30,000+'; the Vanco press release does not show the self-serve directory path works for a small consumer app). Key confidence changes: RightNow's headline should be quoted as '20K+ paying / 30K+ claimed'; Planning Center's working figure is 78,000+ vendor-stated but is an account ceiling (~21% of US congregations, incl. free/international), not reach; Lifeway's 200K+/month is lowered further because the network roster has changed and 'reached monthly' is likely not podcast-only. The single most decision-relevant unknown remains whether Planning Center's integrations directory drives any discovery for a consumer-facing app; both sides searched and found no first-hand account. Also flagged for downstream: Group Answers Podcast may no longer be active, and the TGC 40M-vs-6M gap is better read as a unit difference (annual uniques vs. monthly visits) than as 7x inflation.
